title: public forms: the submit door accepts a value outside a form row's declared `options` subset, and the renderer offers every option
body:
domain:ui#4 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CbDAucNyQ4UtzCJKyh

carries item 1 of #27398 (row 1: a public form row's `options` subset); #27398 keeps items 2–3 (the empty currency placeholder, the thank-you page's record holes).

Filing gate: ① product defect on a guest-facing write door, split from #27398 on triage's instruction (comment 6489228848: 「The `domain:ui` seat files it as its own card, `domain:server` at p2, before picking rows」).

## Business reason

Who: any tenant that publishes a web form and narrows a field's choices on it, e.g. HotCRM's web-to-case form, where the maintainer ruled a guest may pick at most High priority. What happens today: the form serves the subset, but the console renders all of the field's options, and `POST /api/v1/forms/NAME/submit` accepts a value outside the subset, so a guest can file a Critical case. Without the fix a form author cannot restrict what an anonymous visitor writes; HotCRM had to drop the field from its form and cap the value in a hook.

## Where

- Submit door: `packages/rest/src/form-routes.ts` (`registerFormEndpoints`) — per the HotCRM measurement it checks keys and required fields only; the row's `options` subset is not enforced. ⚠️ Measured on 18.2.0 (hotcrm#2368 comment 6488327868, `GET /forms/support` serves the subset; a posted value outside it is accepted); not re-measured on `main` by this seat.
- Renderer: the console public-form page (`ui/apps/console/src/components/FormPage.tsx`) offers the field's full option list instead of the row's subset.

## Acceptance

- The submit door refuses (400, field named) a value outside the row's declared `options` subset; a value inside it still saves.
- The public form renders only the row's subset.
- Pinned by a REST test on the submit door and a console test on the rendered choices.

## Reader who acts

Triage routes it (its instruction names `domain:server` p2 for the door); the renderer half is `domain:ui` (`FormPage.tsx` currently carries seat 1's #27496 in flight, so it lands after that).

## reach

Public door: `POST /api/v1/forms/support/submit` on HotCRM 18.2.0 accepted a value outside the `[low, medium, high]` subset (hotcrm#2368 report, screenshot `probe-form-option-subset-ignored-en.png`).

## Dedupe

Search API is unavailable from this session; read instead: the 500 most recently created issues (open and closed) by title, grep `option.*subset|subset.*option|public form.*option` → 1 hit: #27398 (the parent). No duplicate.

Links back: #27398
